problems.problem: Contact detail (crop 404,1099-1064,1349) confirms a real contact shadow under the left star tip at base_y 1239, so contact is NOT absent and offset_y 0 is correct. However the shadow footprint is only the 51px tip point: the lower-right star point hangs ~70px above the honed aluminium with zero occlusion or reflection beneath it, so the flacon reads as balanced on a needlepoint. On a honed metal ground (concept cites R8's reflective floor) the missing faint reflected image of the star under the base is the strongest cue of pasting.

The wall's broad sheen band sits brightest exactly behind the 'Mugler'/'Angel' text column (visible as the light vertical wash at x~100-400, y~400-800), while the right half behind the bottle is darker. Light logic is inverted: the hero product sits in the dull zone and the empty wall competes with the ink column. The horizon at y~1110 also runs straight through the translucent star body, and the glass picks up no tint or reflection from the metal ground behind/below it.

Hierarchy is under-scaled versus references: title bbox is only 295x94px (~27% canvas width) against a 500px-wide bottle, so the type column reads as a caption, not an instrument nameplate. The 130px steel-blue rule at y=720 floats ~50px below the title baseline with no anchoring element, and the subtitle/price slots are empty, leaving the left column visually starved next to the dense star silhouette.

Vertical rhythm is loose: logo top (490) aligns with bottle top (490) which is good, but the 200px gap between title block bottom (670) and the decoration rule (720-722) and then 560px of empty wall below the rule makes the left column dissolve; references (R1 zoned paper order) keep column elements in a tight stacked measure. Bottle right edge at x=984 leaves only 96px margin versus 484px of left space, slightly crowding the hero against the frame edge.

changes.value: Anodized aluminium wall in cool steel blue-grey with fine circular brush grain, meeting a continuous honed aluminium ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame; the wall darkens gently toward the left third and carries one broad calm sheen band centered behind the right half where the object will stand; the honed ground shows a faint soft vertical reflection and slight tonal deepening directly under the standing object; cool diffuse twilight illumination, matte metal grain, no hard shadows, no objects
